text: Owner decision 2026-09-18: split. Baseline scope is OLS over a non-empty PredictorSet of Mass on one grid with explicit intercept, coefficients, a Signed residual and descriptive R², checked against a rational oracle and against eyesim's template_regression and template_multireg under lm. Least squares is a small hand-rolled Householder QR for tall-skinny problems in design (no gale, no R). NNLS, simplex-constrained weights and partial association move to a separate ticket outside the baseline epic.
